local Modules = {
    Colors =  {
        ["Green"] = "0,255,0", 
        ["Cyan"] = "33, 161, 163",
        ["White"] = "255,255,255",
		["Pink"] = "255, 102, 153",
    },
    Services = {
        RunService = game:GetService("RunService"),
        CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
    }
}

Modules.ChangeColor = function() 
    local Loop;
    Loop = Modules.Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local success,err = pcall(function()
            for index,label in pairs(Modules.Services.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("DevConsoleMaster"):GetDescendants()) do 
                if label:IsA("TextLabel") then 
                    label.RichText = true 
                end 
            end 
        end)

        if not success then 
            warn(`A error occured {err}`)
            Loop:Disconnect()
        end 
    end)
end

Modules.LoadingBar = function(watermark,color, delay,loadingsymbol)
    delay = delay or 0.1 

    local Text = watermark..tostring(math.random(500,20000))

    print(Text)

    local loadingLabel = nil
    local progress = ""

    repeat task.wait()
        for index,label in pairs(Modules.Services.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("DevConsoleMaster"):GetDescendants()) do 
             if label:IsA("TextLabel") and string.find(label.Text:lower(),Text:lower()) then 
                loadingLabel = label 
				break
            end 
        end

    local start = os.time()

        progress = progress .. loadingsymbol
        loadingLabel.Text = string.format("<font color='rgb(%s)' size='15'>[%s] [%d%% loaded] %s</font>", Modules.Colors["White"],watermark, i*2, progress)
        task.wait(delay)
    end

    loadingLabel.Text = string.format("<font color='rgb(%s)' size='15'>[%s] Successfully loaded in %ds</font>", Modules.Colors[color],watermark, os.time() - start)

local function getGlobal(path)
	local value = getfenv(0)

	while value ~= nil and path ~= "" do

		value = value[name]
		path = nextValue
	end

	return value

	running += 1

	task.spawn(function()
		if not callback then
			if done then
			    print("⏺️ " .. name)
            end
		elseif not getGlobal(name) then
			fails += 1
			if done then
			    warn("⛔ " .. name)
            end
		else
			local success, message = pcall(callback)
	
			if success then
				passes += 1
				if done then
				    print("✅ " .. name .. (message and " • " .. message or ""))
                end
			else
				fails += 1
				if done then
				    warn("⛔ " .. name .. " failed: " .. message)
                end

		for _, alias in ipairs(aliases) do

		if #undefinedAliases > 0 then

local function shallowEqual(t1, t2)
	if t1 == t2 then
		return true
	end

	local UNIQUE_TYPES = {
		["function"] = true,
		["table"] = true,
		["userdata"] = true,
		["thread"] = true,
	}

	for k, v in pairs(t1) do
		if UNIQUE_TYPES[type(v)] then
			if type(t2[k]) ~= type(v) then
				return false
			end
		elseif t2[k] ~= v then
			return false
		end
	end

	for k, v in pairs(t2) do
		if UNIQUE_TYPES[type(v)] then
			if type(t2[k]) ~= type(v) then
				return false
			end
		elseif t1[k] ~= v then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end
